entries.reason: Intel Iris Xe over DX12 draws stale memory: wgpu-hal 30.0.1 creates its committed resources with D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_CREATE_NOT_ZEROED and the driver skips all-zero blocks of the initializing copy. The wgpu-hal fix is not taken yet; any test reading such a texture can fail, the set varies from run to run.
